Dear Mr. Karthik Raman,

Subject: Offer of employment as Graduate Engineer Trainee

We are pleased to offer you the position of Graduate Engineer Trainee at our Chennai office.
Your date of joining will be 1 August 2026.
Your total annual CTC will be Rs. 3,60,000 as per the structure below.

Component | Amount (INR per annum)
Basic Salary | 1,44,000
House Rent Allowance | 57,600
Special Allowance | 1,34,194
Employer PF Contribution | 17,280
Gratuity | 6,926

Provident Fund contributions are restricted to the statutory wage ceiling of Rs. 15,000 per month.
You will be on probation for 6 months from your date of joining.
You are required to serve the company for a minimum period of 24 months from your date of joining, failing which you shall pay Rs. 1,00,000 as liquidated damages.
The company shall recover Rs. 50,000 towards training costs if you leave within 12 months of joining.
After confirmation, the notice period is 60 days.
